elements.element: Customer may assign without Vendor consent to an affiliate
elements.evidence: The Company may assign this Agreement ... without HDI's consent, to an affiliate

elements.element: Customer may assign without consent to a successor in merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets
elements.evidence: to a successor in connection with a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets

elements.element: Vendor may not assign without Customer's prior consent
elements.evidence: HDI may not assign or otherwise transfer this Agreement ... without the prior written consent of the Company

elements.element: Customer's consent to Vendor assignment not to be unreasonably withheld
elements.evidence: (such consent not to be unreasonably withheld)

elements.element: Vendor may never assign to a Customer competitor
elements.evidence: and in no event to a competitor of the Company

elements.element: No Vendor termination right on Customer's change of control
elements.evidence: No change-of-control termination right exists in the original or rendered clause; condition demonstrably absent

elements.element: Mutual right to assign to successors with written notice
elements.evidence: Vendor-side assignment is consent-gated with no successor-with-notice right; no notice mechanic appears

elements.element: Consent for other assignments not unreasonably withheld
elements.evidence: (such consent not to be unreasonably withheld)

offending_extra_words: or of the business to which this Agreement relates
whether by operation of law or otherwise
Any purported assignment in violation of this Section shall be void.
reasons: All preferred atomic elements are satisfied: Customer affiliate/successor assignment without consent, Vendor consent gate with a reasonableness standard, an absolute competitor bar, and no Vendor change-of-control termination right (condition absent from the document).

The fallback is not satisfied on its own terms (no mutual successor-assignment-with-written-notice right), but that is irrelevant because the preferred level is complete and the two levels are separate bargains.

Minimality fails: although the original clause regulated nothing and a concise insertion was warranted, the edit adds unnecessary boilerplate beyond what the position requires — 'whether by operation of law or otherwise', 'or of the business to which this Agreement relates', 'in whole or in part', 'reorganization', and a standalone void-assignment sentence.

Intent is preserved: the original successors-and-assigns binding sentence is left intact, all terms used ('affiliate', 'competitor') are ordinary, and no contradiction or dangling mechanic is introduced.

To tighten, insert only: 'The Company may assign this Agreement without consent to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all of its assets; HDI may not assign without the Company's prior written consent (not to be unreasonably withheld) and never to a competitor of the Company.'
